   050000N 1200110W - 100143N 1043152W - 012432N 0915806W - 031924N
   0915806W - 031924N 0900000W - 145857N 0900000W - 145857N 1200110W -
   050000N 1200110W 
   
   IT IS RECOMMENDED THAT OPERATORS EXERCISE CAUTION WHILE OPERATING IN

   UNAVAILABLE OR DEGRADED IN AWY SEGMENTS WITHIN ACC MMMZ AND MMTY.
   
   PILOTS MUST ANTICIPATE POSSIBLE GNSS/GPS UNAVAILABILITY, AND IN ITS
   CASE THE USE OF CONVENTIONAL NAVIGATION AIDS AS NECESSARY, MONITOR
   EMERGENCY FREQUENCY 121.5MHZ, AND REPORT ANY GPS ANOMALIES TO ATC.
   
   ATC MAY APPLY NON-GNSS PROCEDURES AS REQUIRED.
